The capture retains every candidate and every original content byte losslessly; bounded reconstruction precedes unchanged digest, canonical shape and decision checks. No field is dropped or summarized. Corruption, over-expansion and stale recapture fail closed.
The accepted S14 runtime-charge parity, independent accounting oracle, cutoffs, anchored claim and exact-limit acceptance / one-byte-over refusal remain green without weakening their assertions.
